plan.title: AQ-OS Requirements — honest program-level completion (owner review required)
plan.goal: The program-level requirement map: every Foundation/Product/Track/cross-cutting requirement the owner wants, on the honest tier scale. FIRST CUT assembled from the unified plan + 43 PRDs — OWNER MUST REVIEW/CORRECT; the orchestrator does not decide what is 'done'.
success_criteria: Every major requirement area accounted for, honestly marked
Nothing reads complete without VALIDATED + owner acceptance
The gap between PRDs and tracked execution is made visible and resolved
plan.tier_model: DEFINED=PRD/plan exists (designed); INTEGRATED=implemented + wired; VALIDATED=works end-to-end; ACCEPTED=owner signed off. detection.freeze_record = the PRD (existence proves DESIGNED, not done).
